copy.tagline: 遵循测试驱动开发流程分阶段完成开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按测试驱动方式规范地完成开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Follow a test-driven development workflow to complete development tasks in phases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to follow a strict test-driven workflow in your development tasks.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 按 Conductor 的 TDD 流程做任务：先写会失败的测试（RED），再改到通过并重构；在阶段检查点停下等你批准；管理每个任务的 git 提交与 notes，按验证协议过质量门，并把进度写进 plan.md。
howto.when: 当你要按 Conductor 的 TDD 工作流实现 plan.md 里的任务、处理阶段检查点，或管理任务的 git 提交等情况时，它接管流程。

say.text: 按 TDD 流程开始实现 plan.md 里的这个任务
say.note: 先写失败测试，再实现到通过。

say.text: 把这次任务的进度记进 plan.md
say.note: 任务完成后立即更新计划文件。

say.text: 为这次改动写一条 git 提交和 note
say.note: 一次提交对应一个逻辑改动。

howto.what_en: It makes Claude follow Conductor's TDD workflow: write a failing test first (RED), make it pass, refactor; pause at phase checkpoints for your approval; manage each task's git commits and notes; and record progress in plan.md.
howto.when_en: Use it when implementing tasks from a track's plan.md, following the TDD red-green-refactor cycle, handling phase checkpoints, managing git commits, or applying the verification protocol.

say_en.text: Start implementing this task from plan.md with the TDD flow
Update plan.md with the progress of this task
say_en.note: Updates the plan right after the task.

say_en.text: Write a git commit and note for this change
